limitations: GET byte checks do not execute the app, verify accessibility or features, or exercise service-worker activation and existing browser caches.
Only selected changed runtime assets plus the app boot shell and critical reader/engine modules are checked; unchanged dependencies and other locales are outside coverage.
URL reference checks use complete static same-origin HTTPS literals. Dynamically assembled or absent references are recorded as unavailable, never inferred.
The manifest main assets are resolved through the committed shell attributes; the manifest itself may use root paths despite the /app/ shell using relative paths.
A mismatch can indicate deployment propagation or wrong published bytes; this helper does not retry, repair, or deploy.
